parameters.name: kRq
parameters.description: kappa_R^q, WR/ZR coupling normalization to quarks, Eqs. (2) and (6); benchmark 1.0

parameters.name: kRl
parameters.description: kappa_R^l, WR/ZR coupling normalization to leptons, Eqs. (3) and (6); benchmark 1.0

parameters.name: VCKMR
parameters.description: Right-handed CKM matrix V_CKM', diagonal with unit entries, Eq. (2) and Sec. II

parameters.name: YR
parameters.description: Heavy-light lepton mixing matrix Y_lm', benchmark |Y_eN1|=|Y_muN2|=|Y_tauN3|=1, Eq. (5)

parameters.name: X
parameters.description: Light-heavy neutrino mixing matrix X_lm, Eq. (4); benchmark |X|=0 so the nu^c term of Eq. (3) is dropped

parameters.name: normZRq
parameters.description: Overall ZR normalization for quarks: -kappa_R^q g / Sqrt[1-(1/kappa_R^q)^2 tan^2 theta_W], Eq. (6)

parameters.name: normZRl
parameters.description: Overall ZR normalization for leptons: -kappa_R^l g / Sqrt[1-(1/kappa_R^l)^2 tan^2 theta_W], Eq. (6)

parameters.name: cZqL
parameters.description: ZR coupling to u_L and d_L: norm * (T3L-Q) kappa^-2 tan^2, T3L-Q = -1/6, Eq. (7)

parameters.name: cZuR
parameters.description: ZR coupling to u_R: norm * (T3R - kappa^-2 tan^2 Q), T3R=1/2, Q=2/3, Eq. (8)

parameters.name: cZdR
parameters.description: ZR coupling to d_R: norm * (T3R - kappa^-2 tan^2 Q), T3R=-1/2, Q=-1/3, Eq. (8)

parameters.name: cZlL
parameters.description: ZR coupling to e_L and nu_L: norm * (T3L-Q) kappa^-2 tan^2 = 1/2, Eqs. (7)

parameters.name: cZeR
parameters.description: ZR coupling to e_R: norm * (T3R - kappa^-2 tan^2 Q), T3R=-1/2, Q=-1, Eq. (8)

parameters.name: cZNR
parameters.description: ZR coupling to N_R: norm * g_R with g_R = T3R = 1/2, Q = 0, Eq. (8)

lagrangian_terms.name: LWRkin
lagrangian_terms.expression: -1/2 FS[WRbar, mu, nu] FS[WR, mu, nu] + MWR^2 WRbar[mu] WR[mu]

lagrangian_terms.name: LZRkin
lagrangian_terms.expression: -1/4 FS[ZR, mu, nu] FS[ZR, mu, nu] + 1/2 MZR^2 ZR[mu] ZR[mu]

lagrangian_terms.name: LNkin
lagrangian_terms.expression: I/2 NRbar.Ga[mu].del[NR, mu] - 1/2 MN1 N1bar.N1 - 1/2 MN2 N2bar.N2 - 1/2 MN3 N3bar.N3

lagrangian_terms.name: LWRqq
lagrangian_terms.expression: -(kRq gw/Sqrt[2]) uqbar.VCKMR.Ga[mu].ProjP.dq WR[mu] + HC[-(kRq gw/Sqrt[2]) uqbar.VCKMR.Ga[mu].ProjP.dq WR[mu]]

lagrangian_terms.name: LWRln
lagrangian_terms.expression: -(kRl gw/Sqrt[2]) NRbar.YR.Ga[mu].ProjP.l WR[mu] + HC[-(kRl gw/Sqrt[2]) NRbar.YR.Ga[mu].ProjP.l WR[mu]]

lagrangian_terms.name: LZRff
lagrangian_terms.expression: ZR[mu] (cZqL uqbar.Ga[mu].ProjM.uq + cZuR uqbar.Ga[mu].ProjP.uq + cZqL dqbar.Ga[mu].ProjM.dq + cZdR dqbar.Ga[mu].ProjP.dq + cZlL lbar.Ga[mu].ProjM.l + cZeR lbar.Ga[mu].ProjP.l + cZlL vlbar.Ga[mu].ProjM.vl + cZNR NRbar.Ga[mu].ProjP.NR)

lagrangian_terms.name: LTotal
lagrangian_terms.expression: LWRkin + LZRkin + LNkin + LWRqq + LWRln + LZRff
